name: Health and Happiness (H&H) International Holdings Limited
summary: Health and Happiness (H&H) International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells pediatric nutrition, baby care, adult nutrition and care, and pet nutrition and care products in Mainland China, Australia, New Zealand, North America, and internationally.
